question:
Choose the one which can be substituted for the given sentence.

A person who is extremely selective or difficult to please
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Fastidious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fastidious"** refers to a person who is very attentive to and concerned about accuracy, detail, or cleanliness; such a person is often difficult to please. (अतिसंवेदनशील, नखरेबाज)

 
 
• **Example:** She is so fastidious about her work that she double-checks every detail multiple times.
 
 
 
• A **"Fastidious"** person is often considered highly selective and may have high standards for everything. (नखरीला)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Docile** (विनम्र, आज्ञाकारी): A person or animal that is easy to teach, control, or manage.

 
 
• **Example:** The puppy was so docile that it quickly learned all the commands.
 
 
 
• **Hostile** (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Showing or feeling opposition or dislike; unfriendly.
 
 
• **Example:** The villagers were initially hostile to the idea of building a factory nearby.
 
 
 
• **Gullible** (भोला-भाला): Easily persuaded to believe something; credulous.
 
 
• **Example:** He is so gullible that he believed the fake email promising him a million dollars.
